jobs.description: As a Medical Consultant you will support our customers in Poland. The positions require fluency in the respective local languages and include the opportunity to support additional customers in English (or German), as required.You will play a key role in supporting veterinary practitioners with diagnostic test selection, interpretation of laboratory results and case management, including treatment options.We welcome applications from Board‑Certified Internal Medicine Specialists (ECVIM or ACVIM), as well as experienced veterinarians with a strong clinical focus and practical experience in Small Animal Internal Medicine. If you enjoy complex case discussions and would value the opportunity to share your expertise, this role offers a new and rewarding professional challenge.Would you enjoy working from home, providing expert telephone consultations to veterinary surgeons in practice? If so, we would love to hear from you — apply today and become part of our collaborative, international team.The TeamThe Medical Consulting Team at IDEXX is dedicated to enhancing veterinary care through high-quality diagnostic support. We place a strong emphasis on peer-to-peer education and building trusted relationships with colleagues in clinical practice. Our veterinary consultants work closely with our Customer Support colleagues as well as commercial and laboratory teams to ensure the delivery of accurate, practical and clinically relevant diagnostic solutions.In This Role- During regular working hours, you will consult with customers by phone on diagnostic test selection, interpretation of laboratory results (both reference laboratory and in-house testing), and the treatment and management of medical cases.- You will discuss IDEXX diagnostic offerings, including test availability, specimen requirements, clinical utility, and result interpretation.- You will maintain and further develop your medical knowledge through self‑directed learning, attendance at scientific meetings, participation in internal continuing education, and regular review of current literature.- You may be asked to prepare newsletter articles to be included in IDEXX newsletters; writing or reviewing laboratory diagnostic or service updates on new products or services; or preparing other marketing, sales or promotional material.- You may also be asked to participate in IDEXX educational and organizational meetings as required.What You Will Need to Succeed- A veterinary degree with the right to practice.- We welcome applications from experienced clinicians with extensive hands‑on experience in Small Animal Internal Medicine, ideally supported by additional qualifications or equivalent experience or Board-Certification by the European College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ECVIM) or the American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM).- Fluency in Polish as well as English is ideal. Minimum would be English and or English and Czech / Slovakian. Additional language skills (German, Dutch) are an advantage in this international organization- A collaborative, service-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently is essential in our team.- Strong interpersonal, communication, and clinical reasoning skills will be beneficial in this position.- Feeling comfortable to leave your comfort zone from time to time, pragmatic thinking and a high degree of resilience. - Computer literacy and a reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum 100 Mb/s download and 30 Mb/s upload). This is a virtual role and requires the ability to work at a computer for extended periods.- For this position you will work from a home office but might, from time to time, be required to travel.- Starting salary from PLN 140.000 per yearWhat We OfferWhen you join IDEXX, you will find yourself in a challenging but exciting environment where you are given the opportunity to be yourself, innovate, and grow. We have so much to offer!- You will join a successful team who is proud of the work they do and motivated by their unified purpose of helping others.- You will work with people who are inspiring, open, and the best in their operating space.- We believe in you – with a team of over 10,000 employees all over the globe, there are lots of opportunities for learning, personal growth, and career expansion.- You’ll be part of a double-digit growth company in a quickly growing market and we are leading the way forward with innovative products, services, and a strong focus on our customers.Our MissionWe’re proud of the work we do, because our work matters. Every role at IDEXX contributes to enhancing the health and well-being of pets, people, and livestock. With over 10,000 global team members, customers in over 175 countries, and a fast-growing industry - we’re always looking for motivated and inspiring people to join us.A significant portion of our growth is happening all across Europe and with growth comes opportunity! We offer competitive compensation, incentives, and benefits. Our company culture is built on our unified commitment to our mission and our offices are rich with a diversity of languages, cultures, and ways of working.Have we piqued your interest and are ready to learn more? Apply today so that we can connect with you.IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBT individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply.IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited by local, state, or federal laws.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As an Experienced Finance Analyst (f/m/d) Inventory within the Siemens Energy Gas Services Global Service Operations finance team, you will drive financial planning, reporting, and governance for the global inventory portfolio. You will partner closely with finance and operational stakeholders across regions to ensure accurate forecasting, effective inventory valuation, and transparent financial performance. Through your analytical expertise and continuous improvement initiatives, you will support strategic decision-making and strengthen financial governance across the organization.How You’ll Make an Impact * Coordinate global inventory forecasting, annual budgeting, month-end reporting, and management commentary across regions and business units* Analyze inventory KPIs, scorecards, and financial variances, providing insights into performance drivers, risks, and opportunities to leadership* Coordinate inventory reserve forecasting, annual reserve calculations, valuation changes, and alignment of reserve methodologies* Oversee inventory reconciliations, scrap and return-material-authorization requests, inventory adjustments, and annual internal-control testing* Partner with Global Operations Management, Global Business Functions, and Regional Service Units on strategic inventory initiatives, including GRIP, digitalization, and inventory transfers* Drive improvements in inventory reporting, processes, data quality, transparency, and financial governanceWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field* Longstanding experience in FP&A, inventory controlling, or corporate finance, ideally within an industrial or manufacturing environment* Strong knowledge of inventory accounting, valuation, reserves, and financial governance* Proven experience in financial forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and variance analysis* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights and collaborate effectively with international stakeholders* Proficiency in SAP, advanced Excel, and financial digitalization tools; fluent English skills, with German considered an advantageAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

In 2016, IRC Germany was founded and engages in global humanitarian work as well as throughout Germany in the areas of education, economic wellbeing, and safety, legal protection, and empowerment.The Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department runs the IRC’s humanitarian, recovery, and development programs in five regions: West & Central Africa, East Africa, Middle East and North Africa, Asia, and Latin America. Within CRRD, the Award Management Unit (AMU)’s Grants Operations & Analytics Team (GOAT) supports pre- and post-award work for projects managed by Technical Excellence, Global Supply Chain and Airbel.  Major ResponsibilitiesThe Business Development Senior Officer (ECHO), will be responsible for leading a portfolio of business development opportunities, ensuring that all proposals are compelling and submitted in accordance with IRC and Donor policies.Business Development Process (80%)ECHO oversight: Provide IRC Germany oversight to opportunities submitted under ECHO’s Strategic Policies and Strategic Humanitarian Supply Chain HIPs. This will include completing ECHO pre-award checklists and uploads to APPEL. Proposal leadership: Outside of the ECHO HIP season, will serve as Proposal Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Lead the overall proposal development process to ensure submissions are compliant, responsive, and compelling. - Support the technical team to position for anticipated calls, including pre-development of concept notes.- Project manage proposals ensuring internal approvals in line with external submission deadlines- Coordinate with country programs and partners to collect the documents and inputs needed for each proposal Proposal Budget development: Serve as Budget Lead for funding opportunities assigned by the Head of Business Development.- Develop proposal budgets to ensure consistency and accuracy across projects. Design, draft, refine, and finalize budgets and budget narratives (as needed) that are reflective of program design costs.- Ensure appropriate internal formats and donor formats for budget development are used.- Coordinate and liaise with country program finance and grants staff on proposals, providing guidance and feedback on workplans, deadlines, and proposal parameters.- Secure approvals across departments for submissions.Process Support and Feedback (10%)BD Process Improvements: Work on departmental and organisational initiatives to improve IRC’s BD processes.- Support refinement of business development processes for Technical Excellence.- Attend key cross-unit and cross-departmental meetings regarding business development to maintain an in-depth understanding of IRC funding streams and business development priorities.ECHO Awards Management and Compliance (10%)Awards Management: Act as IRC Germany’s post-award focal point for Technical Excellence and Global Supply Chain ECHO awards. - Provide ad-hoc compliance guidance to grants team on ECHO awards- Coordinate with grants team to ensure timely submissions of reports on APPEL.- Monitor ECHO portfolio through participation in project implementation meetings, ensuring progress against objectives and compliance with ECHO guidelines.- Manage donor relationship with ECHO across portfolio.Your ProfileEssential- Experience preparing or submitting proposals to ECHO- 5+ years of progressive work experience connected to business development and working in or closely with Technical teams - Highly collaborative and pro-active colleague with a talent for delivering results with cross-functional groups- Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with organizational information and financial systems- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a multi-cultural environment - University degree in Business Administration, Finance, International Development or a relevant field, or equivalent work experience- You have English language skills at C1 and German B1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CERF) (https://www.europaeischer-referenzrahmen.de/)  Desired- Experience working with IRC systems is a plus- Dedication to diversity, equity and inclusion, and a strong passion for our mission- Comfortable adapting to new challenges and dynamic priorities, while maintaining professional grace - Fluency in French, Spanish or Arabic language a plus We Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary between 60,028 and 67,090 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme, shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal (https://theirc.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Careers/job/Berlin-Germany/Business-Development-Senior-Officer--d-f-m---ECHO-_JR00005896) – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.
